stem: The circumference of a circle is ${=C}$ cm. Find the length of an arc of this circle whose measure is ${=m}^\circ$, in cm.
solution: The arc is the fraction $\frac{{=m}}{360}$ of the whole circle, so its length is that fraction of the circumference.
notes: No book question was supplied for this objective, so parent_question_id is empty. Whole-number answers by construction: C = c*360/m is always an integer for the m values chosen.
